body.purpose: Default text size for messages, descriptions, form content.

heading.purpose: Card titles, dialog titles. Hierarchy via weight 500, not size jump.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, bash output, JSON. Same size as body.

shadows.name: subtle-lift
shadows.purpose: Default shadow for cards and dialogs in light mode. Barely visible.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Hover or elevated state in light mode. Slightly heavier but still restrained.

shadows.name: subtle-lift-dark
shadows.purpose: Default shadow in dark mode. Heavier to compensate for dark background.

shadows.name: raised-dark
shadows.purpose: Hover or elevated state in dark mode.

shadows.name: inset-highlight
shadows.purpose: Top inset highlight simulating light from above. Light mode 0.6, dark mode 0.06.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Primary easing for state transitions, entrance animations, and staggered reveals.

motion.name: ease-smooth
motion.purpose: Secondary easing for ambient/breathing animations and infinite loops.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Quick transitions: toggles, hovers, small UI feedback.

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: Panel and component entrance with staggered delays.

motion.name: duration-ambient
motion.purpose: Workspace ambient animations. Very slow, almost imperceptible. Making the background feel alive, not attracting attention.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: System Blue CTA button for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background-clip: padding-box; font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; user-select: none; background-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); height: 2rem; gap: 0.375rem; padding-left: 0.625rem; padding-right: 0.625rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: oklch(0.588 0.166 257 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.588 0.166 257 / 50%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent button for toolbars and secondary actions. Hover reveals muted background.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; user-select: none; background-color: transparent; color: var(--foreground); height: 2rem; width: 2rem; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.588 0.166 257 / 50%); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Desaturated red for delete and dangerous operations. Tonal, not solid red.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 150ms; outline: none; user-select: none; background-color: oklch(0.52 0.16 25 / 0.1); color: var(--destructive); height: 2rem; gap: 0.375rem; padding-left: 0.625rem; padding-right: 0.625rem; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background-color: oklch(0.52 0.16 25 / 0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.52 0.16 25 / 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.52 0.16 25 / 20%); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-destructive:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Pure white container with tonal layering over Cool Paper background. Shadow is barely visible.
components.html:
Agent Activity
Recent runs and status
Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; border-radius: 0.84rem; background-color: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; padding-top: 1rem; padding-bottom: 1rem; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 2px 6px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.03), inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-card-header { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; padding-left: 1rem; padding-right: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-card-content { padding-left: 1rem; padding-right: 1rem; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Transparent input with hairline border. 32px height matches buttons.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--input); background-color: transparent; padding-left: 0.625rem; padding-right: 0.625rem; padding-top: 0.25rem; padding-bottom: 0.25rem; font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--foreground); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.588 0.166 257 / 50%); } .ds-input:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-input[aria-invalid] { border-color: var(--destructive); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.52 0.16 25 / 20%); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Fully rounded pill badge. 20px height. System Blue default.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.25rem; border-radius: 0.975rem; padding-left: 0.5rem; padding-right: 0.5rem; padding-top: 0.125rem; padding-bottom: 0.125rem; font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; background-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge:hover { background-color: oklch(0.588 0.166 257 / 0.8); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Centered modal with backdrop blur. Pure white popover, shadow + inset highlight.
components.html:
Confirm Action
Are you sure you want to delete this conversation?
components.css: .ds-dialog-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; background-color: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-dialog-content { position: relative; z-index: 50; display: grid; gap: 1rem; width: 100%; max-width: calc(100% - 2rem); border-radius: 0.84rem; background-color: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 2px 6px -2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.03), inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-dialog-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-dialog-title { font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-dialog-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-dialog-footer { display: flex; flex-direction: row-reverse; gap: 0.5rem; justify-content: flex-start; }

narrative.overview:
AChat 的视觉系统是一台精密仪器：微冷中性灰作底，Apple System Blue 作信号，一切信息可扫描、可编排。它不追求情绪化的视觉冲击，而追求操作场景中的冷静可信——像 Apple 系统设置一样，你永远知道该看哪里、该点哪里。

系统的密度偏紧凑：按钮高度 2rem（32px），输入框同高，消息气泡内边距克制。这不是内容消费型产品，而是工作台——每个像素的留白都在为「同时管理 3+ Agent 对话」让路。动效存在但不抢戏：workspace 氛围动画周期 32–90 秒（几乎不可感知），DAG 调度特效只在任务运行时出现。所有动画遵守 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce。

暗色模式不是亮色的附属品——它有自己的色彩校准：背景 oklch(0.13 0.003 280)（#1C1C1E，不是纯黑），主色提亮到 oklch(0.646 0.157 257)（#0A84FF），阴影更重（0.2–0.3 vs 0.03–0.05），inset highlight 更弱（0.06 vs 0.6）。两套主题各自完整。
keyCharacteristics: 微冷中性灰色温（hue ~280），不暖不冷
主色 System Blue 出现在 ≤10% 的屏幕面积，稀少即是分量
默认扁平，深度只来自状态（hover、elevation、focus）
紧凑密度：h-8 按钮与输入框，gap-1.5，px-2.5
动效分两层：交互层（150ms 过渡）+ 氛围层（32–90s 慢呼吸）
明暗双主题各自独立校准，非简单反转

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: 主色 System Blue 出现在不超过 10% 的屏幕面积。它的稀少即是分量——CTA、链接、focus ring、active 指示，仅此而已。大面积使用蓝色等于自毁层级。

rules.name: The Cool Neutral Rule
rules.body: 所有中性灰色调的 hue 锁定在 ~280（微冷方向）。不偏暖不偏冷。暖灰或纯灰都是对色温一致性的破坏。

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: 全系统只使用 Manrope（sans）和 Geist Mono（mono）两支字体。不引入 display 字体——14px 工作台 UI 不需要展示型字体。标题层级通过 weight 500 建立，不通过字体切换。

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: 默认扁平。深度只来自状态：hover、elevation、focus。

rules.name: The Three-Tier Radius Rule
rules.body: 圆角只有三档：lg（6px，交互元素）、xl（8.4px，容器元素）、4xl（15.6px，胶囊元素）。中间档位（md, 2xl, 3xl）只在特殊场景使用。不要在同一层级混用不同圆角——同层同角。

dos: Do 在亮色模式保持阴影透明度 0.03–0.05——这个系统的阴影是「存在但不被感知」的。
Do 使用 tonal layering（色阶分层）建立深度，而非加重阴影。
Do 在暗色模式提亮主色（#0A84FF vs #007AFF）和加重阴影（0.2–0.3 vs 0.03–0.05）。
Do 为所有动画提供 prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 降级。
Do 保持按钮和输入框同高（h-8 / 32px）——视觉节奏的基石。
Do 使用 OKLCH 色彩空间定义颜色——保持色温和亮度的一致性。
donts: Don't 在大面积区域使用 System Blue——它的稀少即是分量（≤10% 屏幕面积）。
Don't 使用暖灰或纯灰——所有中性灰的 hue 锁定在 ~280（微冷方向）。
Don't 引入第三支字体——Manrope + Geist Mono 已覆盖全部场景。
Don't 在工作台主场景使用快速/大面积动画——氛围动画周期 32–90s，交互动画 ≤600ms。
Don't 使用 2px 或更粗的边框——1px Hairline 是这个系统的全部边框语言。
Don't 在暗色模式使用纯黑背景——#1C1C1E 的微亮是刻意校准的。
Don't 为标题引入 display 字体或更大字号——通过 font-weight 500 建立层级，不通过字号跳跃。
